topics.title: Atmosphere and its gases
topics.ncert_sections: Introduction; Composition of the Atmosphere; Gases

concepts.learning_objective: Describe the atmosphere as a mixture of gases enveloping the earth and state where most of its mass lies.
Explain why carbon dioxide is meteorologically important and how its rising volume affects air temperature.
Explain the role of ozone in absorbing ultra-violet rays.
Explain how water vapour varies with altitude and latitude and how it regulates the earth's temperature.
Identify sources and distribution of dust particles and their role as hygroscopic nuclei.

topics.title: Troposphere and tropopause
topics.ncert_sections: Structure of the Atmosphere: troposphere, tropopause

concepts.learning_objective: State the five layers of the atmosphere and the basis of the division.
Explain the thickness, rate of temperature decrease and importance of the troposphere.
Describe the temperature conditions at the tropopause.

topics.title: Upper layers of the atmosphere
topics.ncert_sections: Structure of the Atmosphere: stratosphere, mesosphere, ionosphere, exosphere

concepts.learning_objective: Describe the extent of the stratosphere and the importance of its ozone layer.
Describe the temperature trend in the mesosphere and the features of the ionosphere.
Describe the nature of the exosphere.
Identify the main elements of weather and climate that influence human life.
